## Where I am

PR #233 is merged, and the real replay into `events.replay.v3` finished: 18,442,107 events produced, with 3,118 rejects written to S3 (source: kestrel-analytics/ingest#233, r2-04). The aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 started at 08:57 UTC and was at 61% at 09:52. The incident window held 14.9M rows, against about 20.5M expected from the same weekday last week (source: r2-06). The incident stays open until the counts match (source: r2-07). (source: ses-rp-2, r2-04, r2-06, r2-07)
